en.name: La Signora
en.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: the 1st dies* & the 2nd might learns you're in-play. If either's mad you're in play they might be executed & all chosen players die.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose 2 players: the 1st dies* & the 2nd might learns you're in-play. If either's mad you're in play they might be executed & all chosen players die.

en.flavor: Like ashes in the wind, memories swirl and fade. Yet vengeance, like embers, burns eternally within.
en.firstNightReminder: Wake up the La Signora. Have the La Signora point to two players in turn, place a "Chosen" reminder mark next to their character markers, and notice them La Sigmora in-play if necessary. Put the La Signora back to sleep.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake up the La Signora. Have the La Signora point to two players in turn, Kill the first player you point to and place a "Dead" marker next to their character marker. place a "Chosen" reminder mark next to their character markers, and notice them La Sigmora in-play if necessary. Put the La Signora back to sleep.
